description: Find property leads, owner portfolios or released county data. Ask next_question one at a time, accept unknown/skip, and resend accumulated explicit answers and skipped IDs. Returns real available coverage, source information, preview and current offers. No sign-in or purchase required. An unsupported notice category never falls back to assessment leads.

inputSchema.description: Complete current search input, including accumulated explicit answers, skipped questions and the requested preview page.

answers.description: Accumulated explicit answers for this search. Retain previous choices and omit unknown values; never invent an answer.

county.description: County name or five-digit county FIPS within the selected state. Preserve the user's explicit choice.

dataset_kind.description: For county-record packages, choose assessment observations or recorded ownership data. Availability differs by county.

delivery.description: One-time access or recurring updates, as explicitly selected by the user. Recurring service requires an exact returned reviewed offer.

format.description: Requested preview or download format. Availability depends on the selected product; purchased lead packages require CSV.

kind.description: The user's research goal: property observations, repeated owner-name groups, a county-record package, notices, or a packaged lead product.

lead_offer_id.description: An exact lead_products offer_id returned by this guide after reviewing scope, source date and purchase frequency.

lead_package.description: Exact source-backed package category. Does not imply seller motivation, equity or a future sale.

notice_kind.description: Requested notice category. Unsupported categories remain unavailable and do not fall back to assessment records.

product_id.description: Exact product_id selected from the returned county-record products after reviewing its scope, source and price.

query.description: Address, parcel or retained owner-name label. An explicit empty string browses all records. Omit unknown answers.

state.description: Explicit two-letter state code chosen by the user, such as TN or GA. Omit while unknown.

subscription_offer_id.description: Exact subscription offer_id returned for this same search and source after reviewing its renewal terms.

preview_limit.description: Maximum number of preview rows to return, from 1 through 20; default 5. This does not limit the scope of a purchased package.

preview_offset.description: Zero-based offset for supported property-record or lead-package previews, from 0 through 10000; default 0. Owner-name group previews do not support pagination.

skipped_question_ids.description: Question IDs explicitly skipped by the user. Resend them so those questions are not asked again.

items.description: The returned next_question ID the user chose to skip.

name: gisdb_guide_search
